My family and I look forward to coming to church each week at Canyon Ridge!  We've grown so much in our relationship with Christ through the faithful Bible preaching and teaching.  I love the music on Sundays, the prayer times on Sunday evenings, and the small group Bible studies on Wednesdays!  Wish everyone would come here, experience Canyon Ridge, and grow in Christ . . . !

the services have been nice, everyone seems very pleasant, we LOVE the childcare ladies for our young one, but i don't really appreciate the constant calls, emails, texts, voicemails from individuals with the church. it's just really not my cup of tea. when i had given my contact information, i didn't think i would have to set boundaries for something like this. to each their own, but will most likely quit attending over this & look for a new church.

formatted_address: 10752 Coastwood Rd, San Diego, CA 92127, United States
name: Maranatha Chapel

reviews.text:
Our family has loved and grown in this church for the past 7 years. Big church with a
tight-knit family feel. Lots of programs and ministries for every age. Faith building women's ministry. Amazing children's ministry. Awesome worship. Wonderful friendships. We are blessed and well fed on the Word here.

Found Maranatha online during COVID in Aug 2020. Have never looked back and decided to move to San Diego on Sept 2022 to be closer connected with Maranatha. The best church I’ve ever attended. The teachings are proud and filled with so much love and care.

It’s a big church with family vibes. Everyone I have encountered and met since attending weekly service and women’s weekly Bible studies have been so warm. My life has forever changed by learning from the late Pastor Ray via streamed services and his Step Into the Story series, which is now hosted by his son Pastor Daniel Bentley which is a pure joy.

The worship team is a delight. The music hits my soul and brings such joy to my life. Kayla and Jimmy who lead are outstanding in their talent. Kayla’s voice is heavenly.

If you’re looking for a new church, please come and visit Maranatha. It’s an extraordinary community with many events to feel closer connected to the Lord, each other and offers so much foundational support and strength for this day and age.

I have been forever transformed and found my home. God answered my prayers and can do the same for you.

All around 5+ stars and beyond. I have a twinkle in my eye after going through so much loss this year.

Thank you Maranatha and staff.

Lovely vibes, very welcoming and well attended.  There is s large congregation.  The buildings are nice and the surrounding neighborhood is very nice.  The outdoor courtyard has lots of tables and shading options.

You are going to LOVE this body of believers. A group of Christ-followers who gather to worship and praise, to fellowship through meaningful friendships and tight knit community, to give and serve generously, and to be transformed into the image of God's Son.

The worship isn't some showy performance, it's heart felt and genuine. The preaching has depth bur is also relatable and easy to digest. You don't need a degree in theology to understand the messages.

The pastor is young (mid-40's),so the sermons have a certain energy and enthusiasm to them.

The congregation has a heart for Israel and the Jewish people. They celebrate the Feasts of the Lord.

Come check out Maranatha Chapel, and experience the joy, healing, and presence of the Lord.

Best church for Bible study in our area!!The praise and worship team are the best!!!Pastor Daniel teaches straight from the Bible. Everyone is warm and friendly!!!!I would also like to note I was recently reviewing ' my reviews' for various business and I saw a negative review under my name. IT WAS NOT FROM ME! I have been attending this church for 12 years and it is a WONDERFUL CHURCH HOME!!!!!!

name: Grace Covenant Christian Church of the Harvest

reviews.text: I feel the Spirit of the Lord GOD every time I walk into the sanctuary!  The prayer time, the worship music, the testimonies, the preached WORD, the joy, the fellowship...I could go on and on! It all is firmly based in the Bible and inspires me to run harder and faster for JESUS!!

Super warm, hospitable, caring church. Message- encouraging, practical, talks of real relationship with God. You have to try it. Definitely will return. I can see their eyes were just so sincere and like that theres families there. And all ages. Beautiful people. They sang a song at the close of service that was about unity and helping others. I like whats encouraged here. And I like that they care to know you, your needs. Ive never felt so welcomed like this. I feel they really take care to detail and I feel want to be a place of excellence. Im glad i tried it

When I first visited Grace Covenant I was in desperate need of a church home. I had just given my life to Jesus but needed somewhere special to serve him. I was attending The Rock but not connected to it. I missed the closeness of a real "Church Home" and real praise & worship. I immediately felt loved and welcomed when I stepped into Grace. The genuine love of everyone drew me in but the praise & worship kept me there. I found a place to plant my feet and grow my roots. It has been 7 years I came to Grace on a Tuesday night prayer, and I now am raising my children in this Holy Ghost filled, God fearing, praise & worship lifting Church Home.

This is a spirit filled church! The worship was like no other. You will definitely feel the presence of the Lord! The Word is so rich. The senior Pastor breaks down the word of God so that it is simple to understand. I like how they have other Pastors that brings the word. They all have different ways but it is all powerful! This church spreads a lot of love and are very welcoming.

I came out here to go to school and I was looking for a home away from home. I found it when I came here! Not only do the people here show you so much love, they also preach the truth and you can tell that the relationships that the people have here with God are genuine. It is what inspired me to develop my own close and personal relationship with God, and the teachings that I have received here are what has brought me to this point in my relationship with God today! I HIGHLY RECOMMEND this church for anyone who truly wants to feel the presence of the LORD and grow in his/her walk with Him. I give Grace Covenant Christian Church of the Harvest 5 stars all the way.

formatted_address: 138 28th St, San Diego, CA 92102, United States
name: Total Deliverance Worship Center

reviews.text: If I ever move back to San Diego or just visit I’m going to come to this church. The First Lady is so kind and down to earth. I can tell she spends time in the presence of the Lord and she really has a real relationship with Christ. The Praise and worship was very good, and the word. I was 25 or 26 when I was going there. I was going through a lot while attending, but I left out change.  I also met a few people who really was just there for me and was just beautiful people inwardly. I always think of this church. Thank you for being the real spiritual church that I needed by showing me that the life of Christ is within you!

If you want to freely worship and experience God with no judgements of how you worship then this is the place you want to be. And the place is full of truly loving people. I wanted to join the church the first time I was there but the pastor did not open the doors. He did open the doors the next Sunday and I've been going faithfully for the past 2 1/2 years.

Very nice Worship Center, set up, and comfortable atmosphere too. I didn't feel uncomfortable about anything and the Staff was welcoming. I had only wanted to stop in for a few minutes and all. It's very likely that I'll come by in the future. Thank you for having me today.

Very disrespectful at the pantry. They treated me like trash. I felt so much shame for needing food after this interaction I wished I wasn't alive. I don't know why the people who have zero empathy and racially dis-criminate work at the food pantry.

~ My name is Veronica and I reside in NJ and am caring for my Mother her in So. Florida who has been diagnosed with stage 4 lung cancer in 2009.  She has cancer, but cancer doesn't have her.  Thursday was her last treatment for radiation, Bless God and conversations from that day to Sunday were all confirmed in Pastor Benson's message.  He was slicing and dicing, everybody got some and none was spared.  It was necessary and a blessing  (He that have an ear, let him hear).  This man of God has " THE " true anointing over his life and he is what we ~ TODAY'S CHRISTIANS need!  We've become weak and the sermons have become watered down.  It's time to pick up our crosses and follow Christ.  Thank you so much for being " REAL " and for presenting the word not with fire and brimstone or to bring honor to yourself but with the truth of the Gospel.  It is true, " Man can not live by bread alone, BUT by every Word that proceeds out of the mouth of God.  Thank you for being obedient and for staying at God's feed.  May the God we serve continue to bless and keep you and your family abundantly above anything you could ever hope or think.  Me and Momma will definitely be streaming again ~ we to needed  and will forever need to be re-energized.  We're in a battle, cancer yes but one that has been unleashed into this world.  Please, keep us in prayer and we will do the same for you.  Thank you so very much, may God's Grace and Peace be yours!!

formatted_address: 11740 Bernardo Plaza Ct, San Diego, CA 92128, United States
name: The Church at Rancho Bernardo

reviews.text:
Pastors Jared Herd and Josh Hotsenpiller always gives messages that are really applicable and easy to put into practice and follow. Always encouraged! The people seem nice. It’s a large church so to meet people, you’ll have to get involved with a ministry. Good thing that there seems to be a lot of those here! Biblically sound church with great music. Parking can be challenging.

Living in the San Diego area, I had driven by the church building on the 15 for years. But it wasn’t until I moved out of state that, facing isolation and loneliness, I started listening online to the church weekly. And through those difficult times, my faith really grew and was challenged and instructed through the messages. So upon moving back to the area, when I decided to find a new church, I came back to The Church at RB. And what a great decision it was. The teaching is authentic and fresh and personable. The services are always ones you leave feeling refreshed and rejuvenated. I’d definitely invite you to come see the great work of God going on here!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ An Amazing Church Experience!

I had the pleasure of attending The Church at Rancho Bernardo for the first time, and I was absolutely blown away by the experience! From the moment I walked in, I was welcomed with kindness and love. The people are incredibly friendly, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere that made me feel right at home.

A special thank you to Margarita, who introduced me to Matty, who helped enroll me in the church information system and provided me with a first-time visitor kit—which included valuable church information and even a thoughtful gift! Their hospitality truly made a lasting impression.

The worship team was phenomenal! Their passion and talent in leading worship made me feel like I was experiencing a glimpse of heaven. The presence of God was so powerful, and the music truly prepared my heart for the message.

Pastor Jared delivered an incredible sermon that was both inspiring and deeply rooted in biblical truth. I love his teaching style—clear, engaging, and full of wisdom. He has a great way of making the Christian faith relatable and encouraging for everyone.

Beyond the spiritual experience, the church itself is very well-organized. The sanctuary is spotless, with comfortable seating, and equipped with large screens that make following along seamless. The media team does an outstanding job managing the sound and cameras with cutting-edge technology, ensuring a high-quality worship experience.

I left feeling truly blessed by my time at The Church at Rancho Bernardo. If you are looking for a loving, Christ-centered community, amazing worship, and biblical teaching, I highly recommend visiting!

🙏 I can’t wait to come back!

Horrible experience…I found many employees rude and disrespectful. The church needs some maintenance done to it as well, I’m not going to name names of who was rude and disrespectful to me since it’s a church but just know no one there is really your friend.
The best church, hands down! It's light, funny, the music is awesome and Pastor Jared and Pastor Josh are very passionate about their sermons. Been attending for 6 years.

The worship service the Bible base teaching. It has something for everybody from the young to senior citizens

formatted_address: 4747 College Ave, San Diego, CA 92115, United States
name: College Ave Church

reviews.text: This church is the most dynamic Christian church I have attended and joined in decades. Pastor Chris is a gifted, brilliant pastor that delivers solid Bible teachings in a manner that everyone, young & old can understand and relate. The membership has grown exponentially in the 2 years he has been our pastor. I look forward all week to Sunday mornings in this true spirit filled church.

My husband and I are new to CABC. We are blessed by the sermons because Pastor Chris preaches the truth. The worship is genuine and heart felt. It is so beautiful and warms our heart to see young people love and worship Jesus. We look forward to the start of our Life Group to get plugged in and commune with the body of Christ. God bless!

This church has become my home! Biblically sound teaching, beautiful worship, connecting life groups, amazing youth groups (ALL of them are amazing- kids, middle school, high school, young adults... couldn't speak more highly of these groups and the leaders), and a loving community. I thank the Lord every day for this church.

My son, an active-duty Navy sailor, attended this church five Sundays in a row. In all that time, not a single person made an effort to welcome him beyond asking, “Is this pew taken?” That silence speaks volumes. It’s a sad reflection of what too many modern churches have become—cliquish social clubs rather than places of genuine fellowship and care. If the body of Christ cannot extend even the simplest kindness to a newcomer, especially one serving our country, what message does that send? He won’t be coming back. Sad.

Very friendly & welcoming.  Many young adults attend service here (which is great to see).  Plenty of parking including handicapped parking and accessible entrance.  Very nice to see a ‘donut & coffee’ stand for everyone to enjoy and it’s free.  They also offer water and I think I saw juice offered.  There’s an open air community space has a children’s playground.  There are two areas for worship; the main area and another for overflow.  Another building houses the children’s day care and children’s Sunday school.  Sunday messages are great the Pastor does a great job getting the message across using personal experience and comedic wit, very easy to follow & taking notes.  The music is organized by young adults featuring different singers & songs weekly.  They just readjusted their hours to accommodate more people.  They offer a 6pm service for young adults to attend.  Something I found different is that the Pastor opens his home to “Dessert Meetings” so you can meet him personally but you need to reserve a spot which I find is a great thing to do.  Many times we really don’t meet Pastors on a personal basis so this is a great idea & can’t wait for the next meet-n-greet.  All in all it was a wonderful experience which we will continue to attend.  If you are looking for a place to worship, feel welcomed, want to listen to a great service, meet many people here’s your chance to attend.

This is one of the friendliest, spirit-filled churches I have ever been to. The power of the Word, the presence of God and people who love to worship Jesus. This is true family.
Greatest church ever! Words can’t even describe the transformation that has occurred in an incredibly positive way with myself and family!

fire spirit filled messages every Wednesday and Sunday! NO PLACE I WOULD RATHER BE! + Great community of people!
AwakenU has changed my life!

Awaken Church is exactly what we don’t need more of. I went there and right away they ask for money. I kid you not when I went there a lady shared her testimony of how her family gave everything they have and they received a 3 bedroom house. Their two bedroom house was not enough and they wanted a three bedroom house here in San Diego and felt that if they gave more donations to the church they would be blessed. Also to mention they are anti LGBT. Jesus would love others no matter what. This place is a joke and Jesus would not like to see these evangelical churches making millions a year while thousands of people here in San Diego are homeless or food insecure.

formatted_address: 3810 Bancroft St, San Diego, CA 92104, United States
name: Makers Church

reviews.text: I absolutely love this church! From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed and at home. The people are genuine, kind, and truly care about each other. It feels like more than just a Sunday gathering - it's a real community. What stands out most to me is that Jesus is at the center of everything here — the worship, the teaching, and the way people live out their faith! It's refreshing and life-giving. I'm SO grateful to be part of this church family!!

So thankful for this church! I am grateful for the way Makers teaches belonging before belief—that we are called to Jesus as we are, without having to have everything perfectly figured out before showing up. As a mom of two, I have been especially amazed at how well they love and care for our kiddos. My children are so excited to gather each week because of the intentional, connected, and warm culture Makers has created for both ours kids and adults alike. This is a place for everyone to feel valued and seen through Jesus’ eyes.

This church community just gets it. Truly welcoming, always so warm to newcomers, and appreciates people from all diverse cultures and backgrounds. Never had a negative experience here whatsoever and will most certainly be coming back. Thankful and grateful that Makers Church is here in San Diego for all to enjoy! 🥹🙏🏻

One of the things I love most about Makers Church is that people who haven't been to Makers since it was Mosaic SD are still following the journey of Makers and coming back after being away for college or living abroad, etc. Makers is a welcoming place and I felt so much more connected and involved once I started serving on the Connections Team. Not only do you get connected with other like-minded volunteers but you get connected with the anyone who walks through the doors. Oh - I also love how there are 4+ pastors who rotate preaching each Sunday. It gives such a great balance and difference of perspectives.

Makers Church is awesome! I've grown up going to church, but I have never known a group of people that are more welcoming and authentically doing life with each other than Makers Church people. I'm grateful for Sunday mornings and the creativity and excellence that each service has, but I'm even more stoked with the relationships I've built through community groups and shared life with this group.

reviews.text: I have loved being a part of this church for the past 4 years! It is such a welcoming and supportive community, where everyone can be authentically themselves, no matter their identity or background. I especially appreciate NHU’s commitment to caring for the children in the congregation and for consistent outreach in the neighborhood. Also 10/10 recommend for anyone who has struggled with reconciling their faith after leaving evangelical spaces.

I discovered this wonderful church just a few years ago. I immediately felt the warmth. The love. When they say they are “actively welcoming” they actually mean it. It wasn’t just something they said, it was what they did. Actively. I loved looking around during the service. Every age and gender were there. All were welcome. Ahhh. I found my peeps.

Incredible church!! Queer affirming and teachings rooted in the Bible. Spectacular, loving and engaged community. My wife and I were able to restore our faith thanks to the great community and teachings here.

Amazingly welcoming and low-pressure church environment for people looking for a community who is trying to follow Jesus together toward justice. This church really cares about its neighbors locally and across the county with hands-on opportunities to help without any ego involved. Love this place.

NHU is an amazing, SAFE space of community, reckoning, and some of the sweetest people in SD. It's an imaginative place where every element of the service has been meticulously created. I came to NHU after many years away from church, and they have been a breath of fresh air in my spiritual journey. Thank you NHU!!!

formatted_address: 5951 Village Center Loop Rd, San Diego, CA 92130, United States
name: Saddleback Church San Diego

reviews.text: Pastor Rick Warren is the head pastor based out of Lake Forest, CA in Orange county. There are 20 campuses in southern California and internationally. This is a satellite campus that projects the message on a screen. There is a local campus pastor who welcomes, prays, and gives guidance at the end of each sermon. The worship team is live and unique to each campus. This is the only location in San Diego so far, and has about 400 people each week. Services are 9am and 11am every Sunday. Great for all walks of life. They have children's care and student ministries for the teens. They provide TV screen outside with seating for those who choose to participate there instead of inside. There is usually something fun and extra after the service like kettle corn, bounce house, baptisms, and anything else to encourage people to hang out and fellowship. They encourage everyone to get involved in a small group so that as the church grows bigger, everyone can stay intimately connected.

I was in San Diego on vacation and looked forward to experiencing Saddleback Church.  Warm people, talented worship leaders, a welcome environment for you to experience God and worship him without obstacles.

It was easy to find a parking place, great signage and direction from the parking lot crew.
“Welcome Back” statements by several people when walking in was a little strange, as I was a new visitor, but maybe I look like someone who’s been there before.  *shrug*

It appears that the church is new and growing (or maybe it’s a summer vacancy) as there were quite a few empty seats.

Welcome team was genuine and not invasive.

A lot of the message today was, “You can’t allow your feelings to…”.  Best two moments were scriptures read from Malachi about God hating divorce but not divorcees.  And experiencing God’s forgiveness as a means of forgiving others.

There is freedom in admitting that we fall short, that we don’t have it all together, and that God is forgiving us daily.  Book-study message today communicated forgiving the faults of others, which is hard to do when we don’t soak in God’s grace over our own shortcomings.

Thanks, Church, for providing me a place to worship and experience the presence of God today.

Warmly,
Ryan
It was my dream to be able to finally attend as I do not live in CA. I highly recommend this church to anyone searching for a place to worship.
Pastor Bob Wood was largely instrumental in my walk with building a relationship with Christ.
Very boring. We had to watch the sermon on a screen from their main church in Orange County. I might as well have just stayed home.

This is a YP house church on Thursdays.

The leaders are great. I love them. I won't lie about my feelings and experience. I wish those leaders the best, and to whom ever tried making me feel welcome. I will always remember and appreciate you.

I know God is sending me away from that area, because why would you stay where you don't feel welcome all the time?

I share this experience for people to be wary and always recognized, no matter what setting you attend to, even church, sometimes you will be excluded.

They still act like I dont exist when I'm right there in front of them.

Still grateful to have gone.

For the second time, I was rejected from working with the children. I mentioned my experience and everything. The hypocrisy is unreal. I know I am not welcome by several people. I know this church does not want me here.

I know I'm better off where people don't welcome me.

To add ontop. I was attending a Sexual Freedom Ministry for freedom and everything.

They called me to tell me they dont feel equipped to handle that issues, and the MINISTRY COULDNT HELP ME

God help me.

Rejected every damn where. This place is truly isolating. No community here.

This was my first review here: A wonderful sermon. This was my first day attending this church. And rarely do you find pastors speaking about how fasting brings you closer to God, closer to your spirit.

100% recommend. It was a great experience.

Grace Church is family. I love the house church model of mid-week community and doing life together. We are a missional church and always have Biblically-based, Christ-centered sermons. The Young Professionals group is fabulous for anyone new in town and there are a lot of young families here!

Overall, this is a very good church.  "House church" and volunteering enables you to get connected with others in the church. The only thing I don't like about this church is the fact that they ask for tithes.

I visit San Diego almost monthly, today on my way to Grace, I prayed for God's guidance. No one knows me at this church, and every time I attend the people are so welcoming.
Pastor Josh didn't realize when preparing todays message, he was preparing to answer my prayers! Praise God!

reviews.text: I have been attending services here for about 10 years (even before it was called PLC) and absolutely love it! Once you’ve heard one of Pastor Steve’s messages you will want to hear more! Come as you are. Everyone is super chill.
Pacific life church is a “come as you are” church with great worship music and a great community. The messages are powerful and relevant to our everyday lives. I highly recommend checking out PLC!

Great small friendly church. Come as you are, wear flip flops and shorts and fit right in! Pastor Steve is a great speaker and the messages are relevant for today. You won't feel lost, definitely NOT a "megachurch".

Pacific Life Church has become our family’s new home over the past couple of years. Its warm community of people have made us feel welcomed and genuinely cared for. They provide a great youth group for our teen, and a fun Sunday school program for our 9 yr old. Powerful worship and teachings, wonderful community and kids ministry, great free lunch and opportunity to gather together after service. Powerful serving opportunities and discipleship home gatherings. Service is available inside and outside however one feels comfortable.

Pastor George Clerie is a genuine, caring, insightful, understanding, and joyful human being. Pastor Clerie is in love with Jesus and encourages every human being to build a real deep, and intimate relationship with Jesus, no matter the circumstances. Welcoming church family with commitment to serve locally! The Pastor teaches from the Bible and his applications for Christian life in these times are astoundingly relevant and enlightening. Wonderful Chuch!

formatted_address: 2475 Grand Ave Room 113, San Diego, CA 92109, United States
name: Aloha Church | San Diego

reviews.text: As a Brazilian, I felt very welcomed at Aloha Church in Pacific Beach. The atmosphere is warm, friendly, and full of love. During the summer, services are held outdoors under the trees, which makes the experience even more special. After the service, everyone is invited to a picnic on the grass called “Stay a while”—a lovely opportunity to connect and build community while enjoying delicious food provided by the church! The church also offers small group meetings during the week, called mini-church, which help people grow closer and feel like part of a true family. I love this church; it brings me so much joy!

Aloha Church feels like home. I’m so grateful to have found this place during my time in college. I’ve met so many kind people who really care to see me grow in faith. Drew’s preaching is always engaging, funny & life giving. I highly recommend going to Aloha for a Sunday service! Plus there’s always food after, can’t beat that!

I’ve been to many different churches through the years. Some were wonderful and others I’d like to forget I ever went to but Aloha Church in San Diego has been my most favorite church experience of my life. It is such a sweet group of genuine people from all walks of life.  It doesn’t feel showy or preachy. Just real honest church community.   The stay awhile portion of the service is so sweet.  We all eat together and hang out on the lawn after the worship service. This makes getting to know people so easy.   I highly recommend!!!

Aloha Church is truly a special place! From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted with warm smiles and a genuine sense of welcome. The atmosphere is relaxed and inviting, making it easy to feel at home. It’s clear that this is a family-oriented church, where people of all ages are valued and included. Whether you’re new to faith or have been walking the path for years, Aloha Church offers a supportive and loving community. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a church that feels like ohana!

My wife and I felt instantly welcomed at this church from the very first visit. The sense of community is truly special—everyone is warm, genuine, and eager to connect. What really stood out to us was the hospitality: there’s food at every service, which not only fills the stomach but opens the door to conversation and connection. The small groups have been a blessing too—they make it easy to build deeper relationships and grow together in faith. We’re so grateful to have found a place that feels like home. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a caring, Christ-centered community.

formatted_address: 8283 Ronson Rd, San Diego, CA 92111, United States
name: Redeemer's Grace Church

reviews.text: Faithfulness to scripture marks this church! Not only is the gospel accurately preached (by grace through faith), but all scripture is truly taken as God's authoritative and inerrant word. This is important because our view of God influences how we live our lives and serve our God! Despite being far from home (India!!), this loving and truthful church has become my home in San Diego, and has helped me grow much in my love for the Lord and for the home we have with Him in eternity. Thankful to the Lord's eternal plan in raising up this church in San Diego and for bringing me to be a member of it!

This church loves God and loves His Word and preaches it faithfully not only on Sunday mornings but at every event that is put on.

There is always so many things going on at this church and so many ways for members to grow and be involved in the life of the church from various fellowship events, outreach opportunities, small groups, and classes to deepen one's knowledge of God and the Bible.

When I was a kid I used to be part of the Awana's group.  The fun I had taught me a lot of essential social skills and the sports activities kept me in shape.  Every now and then there is a open to the public barbaque or performance like a magician or acrobats.  I have not been part of the worship community, but I can see how the community this church creates has a positive impact on my neighborhood.  Five stars.

This church has been so helpful in helping me dive deeper into God's word more intently and in helping me hold God's word highly in my own life and in others lives! It is committed to the building up of its members and is focused on giving glory solely to God. Every event has some type of teaching of God's word, and the different fellowship opportunities that are available makes the life of the church so fun to be a part of! I have clearly seen the love of God displayed at this church and I am so glad to call myself a member of this church.

Grounded in the Great Commission (Matthew 28:16-20), this church is a body solely dedicated to the glory of God, and lifting up His name alone. The preaching here is grounded in the Word, the evangelical efforts here are consistent and fervent, the fellowship here is refreshing and of the Spirit. As a foreigner from Canada, the members welcomed me with open arms and have shown me God's grace and love, as well as the staples of San Diego. Could not be more happy to call myself a member!

formatted_address: 5055 Governor Dr, San Diego, CA 92122, United States
name: Canyons Church

reviews.text: I had a hard time finding a church that truly kept its focus on Jesus, until I found Canyons Church. The messages are powerful, the pastor is engaging, and the sense of community is real. I got baptized here and finally felt what church is meant to be. The leadership, worship, and tech teams are all incredible. If you're looking for a church to call home, give Canyons a try and you won’t be disappointed.

My first visit to Canyons Church and I was so impressed. Everyone greeted me and welcomed me as if I was part of the family. The worship was spirit filled and I felt the presence of God during both the worship and the sermon. I love that they went straight into the word following worship. Pastor Matt delivered  scripture rich sermon, and even packed in some humor keeping it light and engaging. I took notes and received greater revelation that will impact my prayer life. I was invited to their community charity event following service where I got to participate in preparing gifts for children in other nations. It was such a joy to be welcomed into this community and I look forward to making Canyons my home church.

We’ve really enjoyed being part of Canyons Church. It has a welcoming, community-oriented environment that makes it easy to feel connected. Pastor Matt shares thoughtful and encouraging messages each week that are both practical and inspiring. We especially appreciate the children’s ministry—it’s engaging, well-organized, and clearly focused on helping kids grow in their faith. There are also plenty of ways to get involved, whether you’re looking to serve, join a group, or just connect with others. It’s been a meaningful place for our family, and we’re happy to call Canyons Church our home!

I feel blessed that we found this church. It is a very family oriented place. The kids ministry is absolutely amazing. Our 5 year old literally counts down the days to Sunday. The pastor and his wife have a genuine gift for connecting with people in a simple way and truly helping us grow closer to God and overcome life challenges.

This church is what I was looking for. Pastor Matt's sermons are biblical, engaging, fun and insightful.  The people are warm and welcoming.  Attendees are of all ages and types.  Bottom line a serious church with a fun and open vibe.  I suggest giving it a try!

formatted_address: 7875 Convoy Ct STE 3, San Diego, CA 92111, United States
name: Kairos Christian Church

reviews.text: Kairos is an awesome church in San Diego. Pastor Peter and the staff are warm, approachable, and genuinely invested in the community. Beyond solid biblical teaching and powerful worship on Sundays, Kairos fosters both emotional and spiritual health. They also embody the “radical middle,” fully embracing both the Spirit and the Word. If you're looking for a church in the area, stay open, take the initiative to get involved, and you’ll find it well worth the effort.

We have been attending Kairos Christian Church for six years. We love the community of Christian believers here who have become our church family. Pastor Peter’s sermons are based on biblical truths which will encourage and convict you to grow closer to God. Our small groups are great and allow for honest discussions and brothers and sisters to pray for one another. We have two young children and are so thankful to have the Children’s Ministry care and nurture them as their own. Come check us out!

Kairos is a Greek word that means divine moment or opportunity. Kairos Christian Church is a welcoming church that offers a community of believers that strive to grow closer to God, individually and as a body of Christ. There is one main service for college, young adults, and young parents. There is a separate service for Children in the same building. Aside from regular Sunday service, there are weekly small group meetings in various locations throughout the San Diego County and regular prayer meetings at the church building.
Kairos is a great place to grow spiritually alongside a Christian community. There is opportunity to do outreach across many fields. The church members are genuinely caring.
Kairos makes my church experience positive. Pastor Peter is so nice and down to earth that you feel like you can talk to him about anything and won't be judged.

formatted_address: 4772 Alvarado Canyon Rd, San Diego, CA 92120, United States
name: Flood Church

reviews.text: Super welcoming staff and community of believers! I love the different ways to get connected and the support you get with your walk with Christ! I went to my first Christmas collective event this year and I was blown away with how upbeat and friendly everyone I interacted with was! This is a relaxed and informative church that welcomes you in wherever you are in your path with God. They truly follow the way of God by meeting you where you are at and helping you grow in your personal relationship with God and grow in community with not just church members but also the community of San Diego! Also I personally have joined and have been participating in the Floods Young Adult group and I have had an awesome experience so far with weekly meetings on Wednesday’s and a super fun retreat we went on this past November! I hope that God blesses this family of a church in their transition to a new building and to continue their amazing contributions to spread the love of God by being a movement of Hope and Healing!

Flood is a wonderful church with a passion for making the world a better place instead of being self-righteous and telling people how they should live. It's quite refreshing and the pastoral staff are wonderful human beings. I highly recommend this church. They set up a wonderful family experience for Easter including bunnies to pet and a wonderful flower backdrop to take Easter pictures to post
Refreshing. Real. ... actually care about what Jesus cared about, not popular trends or politics.

I was going and giving $ for 10 years and could not connect with any members except for one who reached out. Going to the moms groups I was ostracized because I was going through a divorce the other moms made me feel like I had the plague. When I was going through a difficult time with my kids health, I tried to reach out to the pastor I was pretty much ignored. I think if you're a college student you would really like this place if you're single mom, I don't think so. I think I've given up on churches after that experience.

The Christmas Collective was outstanding again this year. Beautiful songs, great community of believers and God's word so appropriate for me. Flood is mostly a young community, but as a more mature woman I feel right at home. It's all in the heart people! God places you where He can use you. Come see for yourself!

formatted_address: 639 E 17th Ave, Escondido, CA 92025, United States
name: Emmanuel Faith Community Church

reviews.text: Great church! Has a thriving children and young adult ministry. A lot of options for adults to connect. Also has Care and Counseling ministry which includes recovery groups. The Spanish speaking community is integrated into main church, which is unique and fantastic!
I have enjoyed this church for 33 years. We drive from South Oceanside to attend EFCC. There are many places to be involved and serve the Lord.

This is an awesome church. It was the second visit, and my wife and I were very happy we did. The worship is great, and the service was awesome. We found a home church. The fiesta Latina was amazing. And the music is very good. This is a great community.

We have been going about 20 years but must comment on Pastor.Ryans sermons.  Every Sunday you know he has prayed and studied for each sermon.  So enjoying  the study of Revelation.  I have taken the study of Revelation twice through Bible Study Fellowship and I have learned so much more through the Pastors sermons.  God bless you in your ministry to us.  Cherie Hudson

First, I am a Christian. In 1980's being  divorced and raising two children is and was no easy task. I felt all alone. (my ex husband also attended EFCC at that time.) I attended the single's Sunday School class and my children also attended their SS classes. We would go to the Sanctuary to hear the sermon. To this day, I don't understand what I did or whatever could have happened, to make the Pastor glare at me during his sermon. There was a volunteer woman counselor whom I thought would keep my counseling private. It turns out, she told others about me in front of me. her actions humiliated me. I asked why she said that and answered me with "I don't know."  There was a serious situation, and i called one of the assistant Pastor's, and asked him if he could come to our home and speak with me and my children. He said:  oh, my, That means I'd have to drive clear across town."  Well, now looking back to that time, I say:  Boo Hoo! Isn't that just too bad! Not to mention the fact that one Sunday a man almost hit me as I was walking across a parking space. I stopped as he flew into the space. Luckily my children were not there> All he said to me was "oh, forgive me, I'm an usher, and I'm late!"  I hate to think what could have happened if my children would have been with me,  My children are now grown ups...they are wonderful, fine people.  I must have done something right....I owe it to Jesus Christ and His Loving Care of us.
I'll sum this all up in a few words:  Just because a cat has kittens in an oven, that doesn't make them biscuits!

formatted_address: 1448 Peach Ave, El Cajon, CA 92021, United States
name: Life Church San Diego

reviews.text: This is a spirit filled God moving Church. It's full of the presence of God. Alot of joy and dancing and praising. Here everyone loves the Lord. Pastor is always on fire for the Lord
This is a beautiful church, that teaches and follows the Gospel of Jesus Christ. Teaches to be Holy Ghost filled and Baptized in Jesus holy name.

Our church is having phenomenal miracles!!! Best church in San Diego CA. I love it so much it's a big help to be there. it's having amazing things in it. People are very friendly and it's a very welcoming station. Try this Everyone!! You're going to love it and it will make your life better.

First time there today Something felt off as soon as I arrived with my wife and daughter, as we were walking to the door I noticed a man outside sitting on a bench he looked uncomfortable like he didn’t want to be inside, as we walked in the door we did not feel welcomed, there was 2 women in the front and we greeted them but they seemed uninterested in greeting us, we went inside to everyone worshipping, once it was done, the pastor read a 1 verse about honoring the elders, they had a family up on the stage, like they were put on a pedestal which I assumed was a pastor and his family, the whole time they were praising them and exalting them, it was more about them than about God, this was very uncomfortable to watch because The word of God calls us to be humble and that we shouldn’t make it about us but about Jesus even pastors aren’t above Christ,  christ is the one that should be praised and exalted, not the pastors, and I believe they dedicated this service to do just that, as they were taking all the praise and glory for themselves my spirit could not take it anymore I told my wife let’s go this isn’t right as I said that I noticed the man that I saw outside get up and walk outside he too didn’t feel comfortable with what was happening, my family and I got up and left because I had seen enough, as we were walking out I heard the pastor say this is my church! Again instead of saying this is Gods church he is putting himself before God. I will not attend this ungodly church and I don’t recommend anyone going there, they seem money hungry I hope this review helps you find a real church that puts Jesus above themselves and where humbleness is found

My Husband Billy and I were there today at the Sunday service,for the very first time,and we immediately felt welcome by the church staff,and also immediately felt the holy spirit as soon as we walked into the church! It felt like a family immediately❤And the senior Pastor Nik, is on 🔥 Fire for JESUS❤We definitely will be coming back❤😇🙏

reviews.text: If you are looking for an excellent church to join, you must visit this church. Everyone is very friendly and welcoming. The worship music is great and all of the sermons I have witnessed are excellent.
Very nice mother's day service.  Solid sermon that is actually scripture based and they aren’t political like some churches in the area which is also is a big plus.  Very welcoming

Daniel and Pastor Tim are life savers!! We were visiting San Diego and had an emergency, Daniel and Pastor Tim welcomed us with open arms and let us use their awesome facilities. Thank You city view church!! 😁😁

City View Church is an extremely friendly place to come get connected with like minded believers.  "Every person counts" is the personal theme of the Pastor's and staff as well as the members.  There are small groups to meet any individual need for community and the corporate times of worship are overflowing with God's presence!!!  Pastor Troy preaches the Word in an unapologetic, dynamic way every week!  Can't think of going anywhere else!

Visiting from Denver Co we found City View Church.  From the moment we got walked in the doors we were greated with a smile and a hug.. We heard such a positive and encouraging word from pastor Troy on doing it MY WAY🎶 ..
Highly  recommended if your in the San Diego area and looking for some fellowship visit the brothers and sisters at city view..

name: University Christian Church (Disciples of Christ)/United Church of Christ

reviews.text: It’s a business, and the man running it does not exemplify a man of God in any way, shape, or form. I’ve never been treated with so little grace and compassion in entire my life, and I grew up in small town churches. This place is a farce. They hide behind a fake veil of inclusivity, but Jesus asked us to LOVE. they do not operate from a place of love or mercy here. He runs a business in Hillcrest. Not a church.
This was an awesome experience! Everyone is so friendly here everyone is welcome this was palm Sunday it was alot of fun service was not long and drawn out either

I’ve been attending this amazing church for about 18 months and I continue to be overwhelmed at the friendliness, creativity, love, and genuine caring that radiates from everyone here.  I am a straight older woman and this is a very diverse congregation that truly welcomes EVERYONE and encourages each of us to be the hands and feet of Jesus in our community, nation, and the world.  We’re actively involved in social justice and vigorously fight for the rights of all people because we’re all children of God!  The pastors and staff are empathetic and caring and we have tons of fun, too.  As part of every Sunday service, we say “I am welcome here.  You are welcome here.  We are welcome here.”  And we truly mean it!

This is a fabulous church to worship God and learn about Jesus. As Christians we go out into the community to be good people and spread, love, warmth and positivity. It is an LGBTQ open and affirming church. Everyone is welcome here. It’s sad when family members are homophobic . We have never had cheesy drag shows. However, there are some fabulously written and performed acts that take place in October for our Theology of Broadway theme. These services will not disappoint and are beautifully portrayed by the loving congregation members. Never a dull moment and we have a fun and positive approach to our children’s Worship and Wonder as well.

I loved going to this church with my Mother Pat Stehlik, whenever I visited her in Mission Hills from Washington state where I live. This church is welcoming and inclusive! I’d even go with her to her Women’s meetings on Thursday afternoons and enjoyed going with her to any special events there at the church when I was visiting!
Always special!

reviews.text: Attended this church years ago when I lived in California, we were a military family moving around. I also attended Word of Life church in Hawaii. Now I’m in NYC. The energy is so uplifting and interesting. Love this house of God!

The head pastor Mill er greatly disrespected my entire family in attendance by walking out of a wedding for my cousin after they paid him for the service. I Can't believe a CHRISTIAN PASTOR would act so disrespectfuly and storm off the way he did like a little girl throwing a fit because the groom and bride didnt want to fork over more money.

Talk about a wolf in sheeps clothing, masquerading around as a Godly individual yet has a cruel dark heart that is lead by a lust for money. What pastor has a helicopter, yet Jesus rode around on a donkey ? Im really happy the back up pastor handled himself respectfully and treated my family with the honor they deserve. The bride and groom are such a beautiful couple and did not deserve the treatment they got from Miller.
The front door greeter was so welcoming! Beautiful worship! Pastor Miller's message is inspiring! You can feel the Holy Spirit in this place! I will be back!
Pastor Tony Miller gave a great word from the Lord. Is the congregation were very friendly and loving and helpful.

Safe and true Word taught here.   I have been to a few churches and have learned to follow along in my bible and understand rather than just trust the word being spoken.  I know the word taught here is the truth the whole truth and nothing but the truth.  Very loving atmosphere.  It has a wonderful mix of culture and age groups.  Lo

reviews.text: You can come as you are. People are warm and very welcoming. The music was great and the atmosphere was amazing. The message was very good and understandable. It’s also got a multi generation demographic. There’s a great kids program and youth group (that meets on Friday nights). They’re invested and regularly have community outreach programs. People are very warm.

This church is my home. I love this place. This is my safe place. It's where I'm able to just be myself and be vulnerable. This church family has supported me and my family through thick and thin. There's no judgment and everyone loves Jesus and their mission is to connect people to Jesus and help them become more christ like. Not to mention all of their holiday events are the best and safe and fun for everyone especially the kids.
It’s a Great Diverse Community of People and everyone is so welcoming and accepting just as you are..
It's a place where you're accepted, loved and led to the One who loves you the most.
Wonderful, Energized in the Spirit of our Lord and Savior, A Great Place to Reconnect and Create a New Beginning... Randy Morton

formatted_address: 6640 Flanders Dr, San Diego, CA 92121, United States
name: The Church in San Diego

reviews.text:
Great place with sound doctrine of the Bible , also very friendly to guests and newcomers .
Visiting San Diego from Ontario CA

Each church out there focuses on different things. This one focuses on two:

1. Scriptural truth. They are very serious on helping everybody understand as many verses in the Bible as possible. They do it in a nice and mutual way by providing all kinds of materials and programs. If you’re interested in understanding the Bible, look no further.

2. Small groups. Have you heard of a church that doesn’t want to get big? This church is so committed in small groups, they actually spin out groups when they get big. (By big I mean about 100 people.) Some church goers may want to walk in and go out of a service talking to nobody. Then this church won’t work for you, but I personally love the warmth and friendship I built up with people who believe in the same thing through the small groups here.
It’s so amazing that no matter where we go.we always meet brothers and sisters in the body of Christ. Praise the lord!

A church community based on the principle of mutuality, the Church in San Diego welcomes people of all backgrounds. They are non-denominational, but this is merely a technical matter. The church that meets here is lovely and family oriented - the members open their homes to meet "house to house". A truly sweet and lovely place!

A practice of the church life on the ground of oneness according to the biblical way with the functioning of all the members of the Body of Christ for the growth unto maturity to fulfill God's eternal purpose.

reviews.text: Jesus Culture is a powerful, spirit-filled church where the messages connect deeply with everyday life. Every sermon feels personal—like it’s guiding you to grow, heal, and become the best version of yourself. There’s no judgment, no homophobia, just a loving community that welcomes everyone. Their focus is building a real relationship with God, no matter your background or religion. The worship is incredible, and the moment you walk in, you can feel the presence of the Holy Spirit. It just feels right—like home.

The most authentic church I've ever attended, I am soooo incredibly blessed to have them as my spiritual family... words cannot express the genuine love for God that ive seen here, and the values they share in Christ!!! I can't imagine being at any other church!!! It's what I've been looking for all along!!!!
Jesus culture is phenomenal!! Worship is off the charts and the Holy Spirit fills the room. Worship team is so set apart! Pastor Zack is amazing. Love everyone at this church. 10/10!🙌🏽

Love the worship team. You are in God's presence when worshipping. Love the Sermons. And how this church has different leaders heading the sermons. Everyone is so welcoming and friendly. It's genuine.

Love this church. It truly feels like family and a home. We don’t follow a rigid structure if the Holy Spirit guides and leads us into a place of worship. I love the variety of those trusted to speak and that the services are filled with scripture. There isn’t judgment for all the different ways folks worship. I came once to check it out and have called this church home since! There are different courses to take to deepen knowledge, truly God filled and transparent about the goals of the church.

reviews.text: I came to The Rock Church El Cajon a few years ago when I needed God to meet me again because we were not in the place that we should have been with each other, and He did. The praise and worship are always outstanding and I can praise with everyone there in our own ways and it is fulfilling for me. Pastor Zeb is a very good receptive pastor. I still attend even though I don't live close to there anymore because Pastor Miles McPherson preaches closest to the word of God and what's going on in these end times that I know of. I don't always agree with how the word is being preached by other pastors of the church, but I believe that's just because I have surpassed the information that is being preached on. I have joined a women's Community because I learned that we are not supposed to do this walk alone and it has been really good for me, and I have met some amazing women. I believe it is necessary to grow even more in Christ and to be able to witness more in Christ.

I visited this church at a 10 am service. I was greeted by no one. I introduced myself as a visitor at the visitor's booth. It was pretty much a help yourself situation. I wasn't even greeted by the greeters. Found my way into the sanctuary, but decided it wasn't a good sign. As I left, one friendly man wished me a good day

I have been a member of this church since 2018. I visited the campus in El Cajon for prayer and assistance and was treated like a nobody. The Pastor wouldn't even talk to me such ashame. Im ashamed to say I WAs apart of this church.
Wonderful, friendly people greet you but it's not for me. I need a minister on site not on a big screen
Loved this place ro worship our RISEN KING AND SAVIOR JESUS CHRIST 🙏 AMEN

reviews.text: Fabulous choir--excited about The Lord! Warm and welcoming, EVER willing to help! Loving, embracing atmosphere! Pastor and his wife  Christ-centered and caring! Families, faith and wisdom of Christians long-steeped In the Word, grappling aptly with life's harsh realities.

I was traveling for business and looking for a place to worship, since I was there for the weekend. After carefully and prayerfully going through a list, I decided to visit here. As I got out of the car, I could hear the praise and worship team singing one of my favorite worship songs, which really blessed me. The leader was so spirit filled and anointed. The service overall was quite refreshing.

Wonderful Church, rich history, great leadership. A loving, welcoming congregation.  Pastor Glenn McKinney is doing a great job transitioning to the future! I'm excited about what God is doing in this ministry and these people!

I Love this church because no matter who you are they welcome you with open arms, no matter what color, race or gender. They are there to help you, lift you up. They are very giving, they do lots of wonderful things for the community and children. They host food give aways, clothing drives, they truly care.

This was a beautiful and underattended sunrise service at Speckles Organ Pavilion at Balboa Park for Easter.
I had trouble finding it when I googled Sunrise Easter Services.
I appreciated the start and ending w organ music, the shout out to Spreckles for donating the organ, to military for their service. I especially enjoyed the gospel singers.
I don't know why this wasn't covered on local news or clearly listed on internet.
It was a lovely service w sunrise in the background.
I will suggest your program list a contact website email for comments after. Thank you for all the congregation members who helped.
Perhaps next year, contact TV stations ahead of time, get listed on Things to do San Diego and get listed wherever Easter Services are mentioned. Perhaps the San Diego Rescue Mission where the offering was going can also provide an email shout out to their donors. I am a regular donor and I only heard of this through Balboa Park Visitor Center.
Thank you for an excellent presentation!
See you next year!

I live across the street. They leave the doors open and you're able to hear the loud music for the whole sermon. People have babies and they cry from the music and dogs bark from it too. I would like to enjoy my peace and quiet on Sundays, not from loud music. Please be considerate of your neighbors and close the doors.

Have been attending this Church for over 10 years, and leading the Celebrate Recovery ministry for +5 years. Was Grove Christian Fellowship, now Coastlands Community Church. Great new Pastoral leadership. Awesome Bible believing, Gospel centered, Spirit filled  and community serving Church. God was in control of this merge. Come join us.

I went to Grove (now Coastlands) for well over 10 years.  Lived in a house owned by the church directly behind the church. Took care of the grounds and always vigilant about keeping a close eye on the entire property. I left the church in Jan, 2017.  Came away very hurt by this church for a variety of reasons.  It was an accumulation over the years that led to a strong sense of betrayal and disillusionment.  I do not know why I stayed as long as I did.  A church should never ever be about hurting anyone.  Primarily it was the the ongoing disillusionment and hurt I received from church leadership off and on over the years. Not a church I would recommend personally.  I do know of others that were hurt in different ways by this church.  I have been afraid of getting involved with another church, in large part, due to my experiences here.

reviews.text: With everything in life, please don’t listen to any negative reviews without checking something out for yourself. This church is amazing and is founded on Gods word. The pastors are so good at what they do and give God all the glory.  Lastly, the worship team made such a fun upbeat environment for singing and praising the Lord ❤️
Really appreciate this church.  Everyone was really welcoming, my kids love Kidz Church and I experience the Holy Spirit every time that I’m here.

I met my beautiful wife at this church!! Awaken church is the friendliest church in San Diego. The community and leaders are here to help us live our lives to the fullest. There’s teaching on all topics like family, marriage, spiritual heath, finances and fellowship.

If you want to discovers God’s purpose on your life (maybe a spouse!), this is the church to plant yourself in!
The Relationships and Discipleship sets this church apart. Speaking Truth with Boldness is what the Church must do. POWERFUL.

Jesus says to love your neighbor. 💔I stopped attending church for exactly this reason (extreme right wing politics). name: Park Hill Church

reviews.text: TL;DR this church saved my faith. In 2020, discouraged by the lack of pastors preaching unity from the pulpit in the midst of racial tensions, I left the church altogether. I spent 2021 deconstructing a faith I’d been born into. After realizing that life without God in community is no better, I decided to dip my toe in church life again, and was led to Park Hill. By the grace of God, I entered a community group where the topics I was struggling with were directly addressed, and was even invited into the racial reconciliation cohort. Here, I had a safe space to wrestle through the issues that pushed me away from church in the first place. The lead pastors were even part of that cohort, not to speak and be heard but simply hear what the vulnerable members of their congregation had to say. I can tell you from experience, that this willingness to hear how the Church had done the vulnerable, wrong, is not a commitment I have seen at other places. The leadership leaning in and making change from the pulpit, preaching against division in this country and emphasizing God’s heart for unity through sound scripture, helped heal my heart for the church. I got to know the lead pastors from a few interactions over the years, and I can tell you that their heart is truly burdened for their flock and for sound biblical teaching in an increasingly divided landscape. To those who put down leadership behind the scenes: it’s true, they’re not perfect, and running any size church is hard. To the person who said the pastors walked right past you: have grace. New people come in all the time, and if you introduce yourself they will welcome you warmly. From my experience and that of many I had met there — genuine Christ followers trying to grow and learn and do better — Park Hill fosters environments that challenges us to put our flesh aside and grow as a body. We need more of this now, Christians unafraid to stand on scripture FOR people, not against them, than ever.

I strongly disagree with the positive reviews. As someone who has had personal interactions with the leadership and specifically Evan, it is not a welcoming place or one of good community. There are many challenges behind the scenes and a lot of turnover in attendance. The cliques are strong and leadership is a mess. The Sunday sermons are fine, but the church itself is one to avoid due to the organizational trouble and failure to provide access to community.

I’ve been at this church multiple years, it has solid biblical teaching and worship with a great community of those seeking to know God in a deeper way. This church teaches directly from the Bible without skirting past controversial topics.

I witnessed a huge lack of integrity in the way the leadership has handled multiple situation’s.  They are divisive. I do not recommend.

reviews.text: Great new church. Casual atmosphere. Sort of a mix of Baptist and non-denominational.  Lots of young adults. She admired their faithfulness to God's word and wanted to steer me away from the histrionics that plague some modern churches today. This is a church focused on God's word, not on manipulating emotions. Through my experience with the New Age movement, I had learned the hard way that while feelings might deceive, the word of God can always be trusted.

I met Pastor Steve, and he not only presented the word in a way that made me feel unjudged but also ensured that I learned something new every time we met. He has been patient with my progress, and I'm thrilled that he was recently appointed head pastor. If you are seeking a reformed church that is Bible-based, focused on community and family, and led by a strong, fearless Christian pastor, come check out Grace Bible Church. You won't be disappointed!

reviews.text: Sound doctrine, with respect and honor shown in the worship on Sundays. This church has strong, authentic community at its roots and is welcoming and loving to all who enter the doors. All are welcome to hear the Word of God preached on Sundays here! Come for the service, stay for the fellowship!

You will not hear trendy topical teaching or feel-good sermons like many charismatic churches you can find online or throughout SD. It really is a simple, Bible- reading and teaching church that holds its member accountable to live as Christ has called us to live. Exactly what my husband and I need to grow as Christians!

reviews.text:
When I awoke late morning Sunday I received a call from my mother, distraught. When I asked what happened I thought you were at church she said to me that church was in fact the problem.

My mother explained to me that she took her service dog with her. She informed me the day before she would be showing up at 9am to make sure it was okay. A little bit before noon someone came to sit near my mother who was not present before service started.When my mother’s dog started growling she took him outside and they locked her out. When she was knocking trying to get in to get the person who drove her to take her home. Some men who claimed to be ushers one by the name of Caleb came out and wouldn’t let her in. They wouldn’t let the person who drove her come out and they pushed my mom down into some bushes. My mother loves the apostolic community and no matter where she moves to she seeks this community for acceptance and guidance.

Beloved congregation, when we gather let us be reminded of the divine teachings that guide our lives and nourish our souls. In the Gospel of Matthew, we are reminded of the profound words of Jesus, who said, 'But I say to you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you.' Let us reflect on these words and strive to embody them in our daily lives.

In the eyes of our Creator, there is no room for hatred or exclusion. As it is written in Galatians 3:28, 'There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free, there is no male and female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.' Let us embrace the diversity within our community and extend our arms in welcome to all!

Furthermore, let us never forget the power of forgiveness. In the Lord's Prayer, we petition, 'forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.' Let us release the burden of resentment and anger from our hearts and instead embrace the liberating grace of forgiveness.

Lastly, let us pledge ourselves to the path of non-violence, following the example of Jesus Christ, who said in Matthew 5:39, 'But I say to you, do not resist the one who is evil. But if anyone slaps you on the right cheek, turn to him the other also.' Let us be instruments of peace in a world too often torn apart by conflict and strife.

As we depart, let us carry with us the light of love, the spirit of inclusion, and the strength of forgiveness. May we live out these principles in our lives and bear witness to the transformative power of faith. Amen.

As a devout churchgoer, it deeply pains me to express my disappointment in the Anchor church. While I went in with an open heart seeking spiritual enlightenment, I left feeling utterly disillusioned. reviews.text: I was sucked into a cult in El Cajon, and then I nearly died in a bike wreck in December 2023. My daughter, a Navy officer, stationed in Mississippi, found this church for me after three weeks of prayer. I went to this place a completely broken man. My second Sunday there, I met with one of the pastors. I tried to explain to him the best I could what I went through in El Cajon. He looked at me and said, "I like your hunger!" After everything I have been through, I am hurting for money, so I asked him if the church could float me $20. He said he would, and then he came back with this enormous kid in his arms. In almost a whisper he said, "I'm out of here." I felt like a complete idiot! I'm kind of old school. I believe that a man should always keep his promises no matter what. I started going to the Men's Fellowship meeting on Thursday nights. I even read most of the material. I brought the matter up with the head pastor. Turns out the guy who runs the Thursday night meetings, Pastor Chris, was the guy who left me hanging when I asked him for money, so, undoubtedly, I had trepidations about attending those meetings at all. I asked them if they could help me with my Last Will and Testament, but the head pastor refused to witness it. He said he needed to get to know me better before he could. I found this disconcerting. There is nothing odd about my will at all. I'm leaving my 2019 F-150 and some real estate to my daughter, and the rest of my assets will be divided evenly among them. I had a meeting with the head pastor, Robert Jewell, and I felt oddly threatened by our conversation. He told me that I was not allowed near the women or children, and that I needed to fellowship only with the men. I have been beaten, robbed and sent to jail since I moved to San Diego in August of 23. I had a respectable career as a software engineer. It took almost every ounce of strength I had to get out of the complex where I was living in El Cajon to safety in Kearny Mesa. What struck me as odd about this church is that there seems to be a lot of money there. Everyone is so well-groomed and well-dressed. I also come from money, but these people struck me as though they were Stepford family cutouts. Then I realized that their game is all about control, so my flight or fight instinct took over, and I told the guy that I would fight my way out if there if necessary. When I got home, I sent him a polite email explaining that I wasn’t a good fit for their church, and he politely acknowledged my message. But then I thought about it, so I sent him another email asking him if he would like to be my pen pal, and that I would like to continue going to the Men’s Fellowship on Thursday nights. I was shocked when he wrote back telling me that I was not welcome in their church at all! Again, I responded politely, saying that their Christian values were way out of whack. And for whatever stupid reason, I sent him a picture of a stab wound on my neck with a caption that read, “Knife fights are no joke!” What I sent him was an obvious cry for help, but instead of reaching out to me, as any good Christian should do, he reported me to the police. Yesterday, a police officer and two case workers from PERT frisked me outside of my apartment in front of all my neighbors. I sat down on the bench and very calmly explained my situation and debunked all the lies this pastor told the police. The experience was humiliating and disturbing to say the least. This only intensified my fear of churches, but I am a rational, thinking man, so instead of being angry about it, I am simply going to file a Civil suit against those idiots. Thankfully, almost all our exchanges are in writing, so I have more than enough ammunition to shake them up pretty good. What they did certainly wasn’t Christian, and upon reflection, I realize that they were simply trying to protect the status quo. Let’s hope they don’t do this to anyone else.

And what does the LORD require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God”-Micah 6:8 NIV. I’m going to again, maybe I’ll see you there.

“Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing but inwardly are ravenous wolves” (Matt 7:13), so there will be many, not a few. We must contend for the faith once delivered (Jude 1:3) because many pretend to offer you a “great gospel” message; a real-good, feel-good message, but “there is another one, but there are some who trouble you and want to distort the gospel of Christ” (Gal 1:7). Paul told the church at Corinth that “if someone comes and proclaims another Jesus than the one we proclaimed, or if you receive a different spirit from the one you received, or if you accept a different gospel from the one you accepted, you put up with it readily enough” (2 Cor 11:4), so “even if we or an angel from heaven should preach to you a gospel contrary to the one we preached to you, let him be accursed” (Gal 1:8). To put an exclamation mark on it, Paul says, “again: If anyone is preaching to you a gospel contrary to the one you received, let him be accursed”

reviews.text: Summit is a polished, timed, and aloof worship experience. If that's what you want, it's very convenient.

When I looked at a pamphlet for a beat too long one just said "Do you have any questions?" making me feel like I was inconveniencing them and 2) the whole sermon was put on by their connection director that day and it was about connecting with the community... which, in my opinion, it felt like they were failing at that.

reviews.text:
A School That’s Helped Both of Our Kids Thrive
Faith Academy has been such a blessing to our family. Adelaide has developed a true heart for worship, and we credit that in large part to the chapel days, such a beautiful way to anchor the week in Christ. Kingston has absolutely thrived academically and personally through the sports homeschool onsite program. Highly recommend to any family looking for a place where their children will be known, challenged, and nurtured in their walk with God.

name: Northwest Church Orlando

reviews.text:
Incredible place. I came from a larger church, searching for a greater sense of community. And boy did I find it. The number of every day, "normal" people is astounding. A lot of churches tout "everybody has a past and youre welcome here in spite of it" but this church lives it. Not only are you welcome in spite of your past, but you are welcomed BECAUSE of it. I have never felt more at home with people I am still learning about. I am a big introvert, not feeling comfortable in a lot of places. But here, I belong. I only wish I had forgone my apprehension of leaving what was "comfortable" sooner, to find this place which is even greater a comfort, but also a body of believers that are constantly challenging each other to be uncomfortable in order to grow. And sunday service is just the cherry on top. The amazing part about this church is how they interact and commune during the week, and live out the faith in their daily lives, willing to help someone they just met without a second thought.

Thank you to everyone who works to make this place the way it is!

This is such a great church. I love that they cater to so many age group. For the last 10 years, I’ve been church shopping trying to figure out which church I belong to and since I’ve been to this church, I haven’t felt the need to go anywhere else. The kids church program is just amazing. I love that they spend so much time with their youth and they’re super involved with the adults as well. I also love that you are agreed with smiles and people come to approach you to make you feel welcome. Great job Northwest! We are happy to be part of the family.

This church has become home for me. I met my husband here and now our kids are hearing the gospel, are cared for, and shown the love of Christ in kids church/nursery.

It’s welcoming and inclusive — I can't walk in and out of the place without being greeted. Super easy to get connected, no matter your background.

Online is wonderful as well — a solid way to stay engaged on a Sunday morning even if I'm not able to make it in-person. Sound, biblical teaching preached week after week.

I absolutely love Northwest Church! From the moment I walked through the doors, I felt welcomed and at home. The people here are so kind and genuine—it truly feels like a family. The worship is powerful, and the messages always seem to speak right to my heart.

Since coming here, I’ve not only grown in my faith, but I’ve also met some of my best friends—people who encourage me, pray for me, and truly do life with me.

If you’re looking for a church where you can grow spiritually and build real, lasting friendships, I can’t recommend Northwest Church enough!

My family and I have been attending Northwest Church for nearly two years, and it has truly been an incredible experience. From the moment we first walked through the doors, we felt welcomed and embraced by a warm and loving community.

The teaching is powerful, biblically grounded, and applicable to everyday life, helping us grow deeper in our faith. The worship is uplifting and spirit-filled, creating an atmosphere where you can truly connect with God.

reviews.text: I'm not much of a religious man and I think they know that but Deacon Rogers and Pastor Spooney still make me feel like family.
